pages.title: About us
pages.content:
Peak Athletics started with three club runners, a van and a stubborn belief: gear should be judged on the hill, not in a catalogue. Every product we sell has been run, lifted, carried or kicked by our test team for at least a month before it reaches the shop.

We keep the range small on purpose. If two shoes do the same job, we only stock the better one, and we tell you exactly why. That makes choosing faster, and it means we know every product inside out when you call with a question.

Our promise

  • 60 days to test anything you buy, worn or not.
  • Real advice from people who train, every weekday.
  • Repairs and spare parts for packs and poles.
  • A share of every sale goes to junior club sport.

posts.title: Your first trail ultra: a 12-week plan
posts.excerpt: From marathon to 50K in twelve weeks, with time on feet, hill repeats and a lot of snacks.
posts.content:
Moving from road marathons to your first trail ultra is less about distance than about time on your feet. A 50K in the hills can take two hours longer than a flat marathon, so the plan builds patience before speed.

Weeks one to four are about volume: three easy runs, one long run that grows by twenty minutes each week, and one session of hill repeats. Weeks five to eight add back-to-back long runs on the weekend so your legs learn to start tired. Weeks nine to twelve sharpen, then taper.

Practise everything you will do on race day: eat every forty minutes, walk the steep climbs on purpose, and test your shoes, pack and poles on long runs. The trail rewards the runner who planned the boring details.

posts.title: A home gym in two square metres
posts.excerpt: Three pieces of kit, one corner of the room and a full-body routine that takes 30 minutes.
posts.content:
You do not need a garage to train properly. Our coach built a full routine around a pair of adjustable dumbbells, a 16 kg kettlebell and a yoga mat, all of which fit in the corner behind a door.

The session is a circuit of five moves: goblet squats, single-arm rows, kettlebell swings, push-ups and a slow plank. Do each for forty seconds, rest for twenty, and repeat the circuit four times.

Progress by adding weight on the dial rather than more rounds. When the last round feels easy, it is time to turn the dial one click.

posts.title: How to pack a 30-litre day pack
posts.excerpt: Heavy things close to your back, snacks within reach, and the jacket always on top.
posts.content:
A well-packed day bag carries lighter than a badly packed one with less in it. The rule is simple: heavy and dense items go close to your back and between your shoulder blades, light and bulky ones go at the bottom and the outside.

Put the water bladder in its sleeve first, then food and the first-aid kit, then a warm layer. Your shell jacket goes on top where you can grab it in thirty seconds, and snacks, map and phone go in the hip-belt and lid pockets.

Tighten the compression straps before you set off so nothing shifts on a descent, and adjust the hip belt so it carries most of the weight. Your shoulders will thank you at the end of the day.

products.name: Trail Runner Shoe
products.description:
A grippy, stable trail shoe with 5 mm lugs, a rock plate under the forefoot and a cushioned midsole that stays lively for the last ten kilometres. The upper is a tough ripstop mesh with a gusseted tongue to keep grit out.

Drop 6 mm, weight 290 g (size 42). Made for mud, scree and everything in between.
products.short_description: Lugged, cushioned and stable: a trail shoe for long days off-road.

reviews.author: Kai
reviews.content: Ran a muddy 30K in these on the weekend and never slipped once. The rock plate is a game changer on scree.

reviews.author: Rosa
reviews.content: Great grip and comfortable from the first run. Size up half if you like room for swollen feet on long runs.

products.name: Running Jacket
products.description:
A featherweight shell that packs into its own chest pocket. Windproof on the front, breathable on the back, with reflective details front and rear for dark mornings.

Weight 120 g. Water-repellent finish without PFCs.
products.short_description: A packable windproof shell with reflective details.

reviews.author: Dev
reviews.content: Folds to the size of a fist and actually blocks the wind. Wear it every winter morning.

products.name: Compression Tights
products.description: Supportive tights with graduated compression through the calf and a wide, flat waistband that does not dig in. Zipped back pocket fits a phone and a gel.
products.short_description: Graduated-compression running tights with a zipped back pocket.

products.name: Adjustable Dumbbells
products.description: A pair of dumbbells that adjust from 2.5 to 24 kg each with a turn of the dial. Fifteen weights in the space of one pair, with a tray that keeps the plates in order.

reviews.author: Marcus
reviews.content: Replaced a whole rack in the garage. The dial is smooth and the plates lock in solidly.

reviews.author: Jo
reviews.content: Brilliant for a flat. The handles are a bit long for curls, but you get used to it.

products.name: Kettlebell 16 kg
products.description: Cast in one piece with a wide, smooth handle that is comfortable for swings, cleans and Turkish get-ups. A flat base keeps it steady on the floor.

products.name: Yoga Mat
products.description: A 5 mm mat with a grippy top and a cushioned natural-rubber base. Alignment lines help with stance, and the carry strap is included.
products.short_description: A grippy 5 mm natural-rubber mat with alignment lines.

products.name: Insulated Bottle
products.description:
Double-walled stainless steel keeps water cold for 24 hours or tea hot for 12. The sport cap opens with one hand and the powder coat will not slip out of a cold glove.

750 ml.
products.short_description: A 750 ml double-walled bottle with a one-hand sport cap.

products.name: Hiking Backpack 30L
products.description: A day pack with a ventilated back panel, a hip belt with pockets and a separate compartment for a hydration bladder. Side pockets swallow a bottle each and the lid has room for a map and snacks.
products.short_description: A ventilated 30-litre day pack with hip-belt pockets.

reviews.author: Aino
reviews.content: Carried it across three days of hut-to-hut hiking. The back panel really keeps you cool.

products.name: Trekking Poles
products.description: A pair of three-section aluminium poles with cork grips and quick-lock clamps. Adjust from 105 to 135 cm and pack down to 62 cm for travel.

products.name: Match Football
products.description: A thermally bonded size-5 ball with a textured skin for a clean strike and true flight. Holds its shape and pressure through a whole season.

products.name: Basketball
products.description: An indoor-outdoor composite ball with deep channels and a pebbled grip that does not get slippery when you sweat. Official size 7.

products.name: Tennis Racket
products.description:
A 100 square inch head with an open string pattern for easy spin and a forgiving sweet spot. Strung and ready to play, with a protective cover.

Weight 285 g unstrung, grip size 2.
products.short_description: A forgiving 100 sq in racket, strung, with a cover.
